subject: Error when uploading evidence file to MSstatsShiny

messages.author: 93f913c7fae0cbce
messages.subject: Error when uploading evidence file to MSstatsShiny
parts:
Hi there,
I'm trying to run MSStats for the first time, using MSstatsShiny. It seems I can't upload my evidence file from MaxQuant even though it is below the size limit ( 180 MB). The error I'm getting says: <html> <head><title>413 Request Entity Too Large</title></head> <body> <center><h1>413
Any ideas on how to solve it?

Many thanks,
Dominika

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: Error when uploading evidence file to MSstatsShiny
parts:
Hi Dominika,

We have lowered the file size recently, in an attempt to keep the server up. It has very low computational resources so really should be used to test smaller files. I would recommend downloading the application locally: 

1. Download R and RStudio - How to. Note R version must be >= 4.3
2. Intall the package via Bioconductor
3. Run the app by typing "MSstatsShiny::launch_MSstatsShiny()" in the console.

In the meantime I will update the documentation to reflect the new upload limit.

Best,
Devon
